basic_info.description:
A beautifully renovated unit located in San Francisco's desirable Portola District! This spacious top-floor 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home has been thoughtfully updated with modern finishes, offering comfort, convenience, and style in every corner. 

Step inside to an open and airy living space filled with natural light. The modern kitchen features sleek cabinetry, updated appliances, and generous counter space perfect for cooking and entertaining. Both bathrooms have been fully remodeled with contemporary fixtures and clean, elegant design.

Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, plus ample street parking, a rare bonus in San Francisco! The garage is not included.

Located just minutes from McLaren Park, freeway access, public transportation, and neighborhood shops, this home is ideal for professionals, roommates, or small families seeking a quiet yet connected lifestyle.

Terms of Rent: - $4,000/month.
- Security deposit of $5,000.
- Lease: 1-year minimum
- Tenant(s) share all utilities (i.e., water, garbage, electricity, gas, etc.) except Wifi. Wifi is Tenant(s)' responsibility
- Good credit score with verification of employment.

Documents Needed:
- Driver's License/ID verification of each Applicant signing lease.
- Two months of paystubs.
- Two months of bank statements.

NO SMOKING.

No smoking allowed. No pets. The renter is fully responsible for Wifi. The rest of the utilities are shared among the number of people living in the house.
